verdict.rationale: Langfuse offers open-source self-hosting (MIT license, Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform deployments) meaning customers can keep all trace data entirely on their own infrastructure, which indirectly prevents any vendor use of that data for model training. However, there is no explicit policy statement, opt-out toggle, or ToS language addressing whether Langfuse Cloud uses customer data for AI training. Missing for 10: explicit no-training-on-customer-data commitment/policy, opt-out controls for cloud users, independent confirmation of this policy.
